desc:
⚔️ Heroes of War| RTS ⚔️

BETA - This game still has a LOT of work it needs

Previously known as "WARFRONT RTS"

Command your OWN army in real-time battles! 🪖

- Build your base and train squads
- Capture points and hold Victory Points
- Take cover behind sandbags and flank the enemy
- Roll out tanks, helicopters and more
- Call in artillery, paratroopers and air support
- Pick your company: Infantry, Airborne or Armored

Battle from 1v1 up to 4v4 with friends or against AI commanders 🤖

Rank up from Private all the way to General ⭐
Earn War Bonds every match 💰

Play on PC, Mobile and Console 🎮

🐞Report Bugs and Complaints on the Group Wall🐞
